skills.name: Common application software 3: graphics, multimedia, communication and utilities

note.text:
Other common applications:
• Graphics: drawing and photo editing (Paint, GIMP, Photoshop); design (Canva, Publisher) for posters and flyers.
• Multimedia: playing and editing audio and video (VLC, Audacity, video editors).
• Web browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Edge) to view websites; search engines to find information.
• Communication: e-mail, messaging (WhatsApp), video calls (Zoom, Google Meet).
• Utilities (system tools): antivirus, file compression (zip), backup, disk clean-up.
General-purpose software does many tasks (a word processor); specialist software does one job (accounting or hospital software).

sections.heading: Images, sound and video
sections.text:
• Graphics software: drawing (Paint), photo editing (GIMP, Photoshop) and design (Canva, Publisher) for posters, flyers and certificates.
• Multimedia software: playing and editing music and video (VLC, Audacity, video editors) for school events, music and adverts.

sections.heading: Internet and communication
sections.text:
• Web browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Edge) display websites; search engines find them.
• E-mail sends letters and files.
• Messaging apps (WhatsApp) and video-call software (Zoom, Google Meet) let people talk and share instantly.
Use them responsibly: protect personal data and think before sharing.

sections.heading: Utilities and choosing software
sections.text:
Utilities look after the computer: antivirus (removes malware), compression (zip files smaller), backup (copies of files), disk clean-up.
General-purpose software can do many jobs (word processors, spreadsheets); specialist software does one job (hospital, banking or school-fees software).
Choose software by the task, cost, ease of use and the files it must open. Free open-source programs such as LibreOffice and GIMP can save money.

worked_example.problem: A youth club in Buea wants to make a colourful poster and share it with members by phone. Which software would they use?
steps: To design the poster: graphics/desktop publishing software (e.g. Canva or Publisher).
To share it: a messaging app such as WhatsApp, or e-mail.
worked_example.answer: Design software, then a messaging or e-mail app
